messages:
Priya S.: Morning team — kickoff for Cobalt Health onboarding. They want to be live in ~6 weeks. Need to align stakeholders, success criteria, timelines, and risks. Draft 30/60/90 below — can people confirm owners?

Priya S.: ```
30d: connectivity + data ingest (staging)
60d: validation, pilot w/ subset of users, tune routing & caching
90d: full rollout, post-launch monitoring + knowledge transfer
```

Ethan L.: I'll own success criteria and account health dashboards. Proposed success criteria:
1) p95 latency for production routes < 250ms (on Dedicated)
2) embeddings recall >= 0.85 on our eval set
3) Token cost per session within 20% of forecast
4) No P0 incidents for 14 days post-pilot

Maya R.: I'll lead integration and enablement. Need sanitized sample dataset + a service account API key from the customer. @Sam T. can you provision a staging shard? :pray:

Sam T.: Yep — provisioning staging on a small Dedicated pool. ETA 3 business days. I'll also create a runbook for smoke tests and invite SE + QA to a weekly sync (proposed Tues 10am PT). First invite sent.

Jules P.: FYI — AM note: Cobalt flagged procurement deadline of Jun 18. If go-live slips past EoQ we should expect pushback / renewed commercial review. Flagging renewal risk — I'll take point on procurement docs and legal checklist.

Ethan L.: Add monitoring + alerts: token spend by route, cache hit rate, model-fallback count, and 5xx error spikes. Alert if cost > 20% baseline or p95 latency breaches SLA. We'll pair that into the dashboard.

OnboardingBot: Created tasks: onboarding/playbooks/cobalt — owners: Priya S., Maya R., Sam T., Ethan L. (task links in playbook).

Priya S.: Feedback capture plan: send a 3-question enablement survey at +7 days and a fuller product feedback form at +30 days. Capture demo notes and any prompt regressions. Maya — can you draft 3 demo prompts for the enablement deck?

Maya R.: Yep — will draft demo prompts and run them by Alex in Docs for writeups. Target to share prompts by end of week.

Sam T.: Quick action-item recap: 
- Maya: sample data + demo prompts (due 3/28)
- Sam: staging shard + invites + runbook (due 3/24)
- Ethan: success criteria + dashboards + alert rules (due 3/29)
- Jules: procurement pack & legal checklist (ongoing)
- Priya: kickoff notes + enablement survey (sending today)

Priya S.: Great — if no major blockers I'll post the kickoff notes and calendar invites in this thread. :thumbsup:

Ethan L.: 👍

Maya R.: :rocket:

Jules P.: Thanks all — I'll loop in Finance for procurement timing.

OnboardingBot: Reminder scheduled: follow-up sync in 7 days (2581235267).
